# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Baidu open-sources 280B-parameter ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/baidu-ernie-55-flash-base.html): Baidu has released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base as open weights, bringing a large sparse model and long-context training recipe into China’s open-model race.
- [Meta acquires Conductor to coordinate coding agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-acquires-conductor-agent-orchestration.html): Meta is acquiring Conductor, whose software lets developers run multiple coding agents in parallel, adding orchestration to its developer strategy.
- [OpenAI Images 2.6 adds GIFs and faster image creation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-images-2-6-gif-generation.html): OpenAI’s latest image release adds animated GIF output, reusable references and faster generation across ChatGPT, Codex and its API.
- [OpenAI to acquire Pierre for agent-ready Git workflows](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-pierre-codex-git-workflows.html): OpenAI plans to buy Pierre, bringing open-source code review and storage tools into Codex as coding agents reshape software development.
- [Apple opens Siri AI app skills to third-party developers](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/apple-opens-siri-ai-app-skills.html): Apple’s latest developer beta lets apps expose richer actions to Siri AI, potentially turning the assistant into a system-wide interface for software.
- [Fal raises $1.3 billion as generative media inference surges](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/fal-raises-inference-capital.html): Generative-media infrastructure company Fal has raised $1.3 billion at a $16 billion valuation, betting that inference demand will keep compounding.
- [Lion-ER-35B-A3B targets efficient embodied reasoning](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/lion-er-embodied-reasoning.html): China’s Lion Mountain Lab has released Lion-ER-35B-A3B, emphasizing capability-driven data design for robots rather than simply scaling training volume.
- [MoWorld 2.0 brings physics-aware 4D scene generation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/moworld-2-4d-world-model.html): MoWorld 2.0 claims deeper handling of physical forces and reusable 4D Gaussian assets, targeting interactive simulation beyond static video generation.
- [OpenAI pushes AI agents deeper into physical engineering](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-ai-engineering-physical-products.html): OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra and Codex now support CAD, simulation and manufacturing workflows, while human engineers still validate every design.
- [Tencent launches Hy4 with vision and agent upgrades](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tencent-hy4-visual-open-model.html): Tencent has launched Hy4 with visual understanding, stronger long-context reasoning and agent capabilities, while promising open weights in the coming days.
- [Anthropic Reports $17 Billion Revenue Ahead of IPO](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-ipo-revenue-compute.html): Anthropic’s amended filing shows explosive revenue growth alongside enormous compute commitments, sharpening questions about frontier AI economics.
- [Anthropic Cuts Long-Context Agent Startup Delays](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-message-threads.html): Anthropic’s message-thread API sends only new context on each turn, cutting median first-token latency by about 35% in huge requests.
- [Huawei Customers Told to Source HBM for AI Chips](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/huawei-hbm-procurement-crunch.html): Huawei is reportedly asking some buyers to procure high-bandwidth memory themselves, exposing a severe constraint in China’s AI-chip supply chain.
- [Nvidia Urges Cloud Partners to Limit China Exposure](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/nvidia-cloud-china-exposure.html): Nvidia is asking cloud customers to diversify away from Chinese clients, tightening a remote-access loophole in US AI-chip controls.
- [OpenAI Proposes Grid Protectors for AI Data Centers](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-grid-protectors-program.html): OpenAI proposed a program for data centers to help protect nearby power systems, linking frontier-AI expansion with local grid reliability.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [百度开源2800亿参数文心5.5 Flash Base](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/baidu-ernie-55-flash-base.html): 百度开源文心5.5 Flash Base，采用稀疏架构与超长上下文，为中国开放权重模型竞争加入新的大规模选手。
- [Meta收购Conductor，押注多智能体编程协作](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-acquires-conductor-agent-orchestration.html): Meta收购Conductor，将其并行调度多个编码智能体的能力纳入自身开发者和企业AI战略。
- [OpenAI发布Images 2.6，支持生成GIF并提速](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-images-2-6-gif-generation.html): OpenAI推出Images 2.6，新增GIF生成、参考图复用和更快的图像生成能力，并同步开放开发者API。
- [OpenAI拟收购Pierre，强化Codex代码协作链](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-pierre-codex-git-workflows.html): OpenAI计划收购开发者工具公司Pierre，将代码浏览、审查和存储能力纳入面向智能体的Codex工作流。
- [苹果向第三方开发者开放Siri AI应用技能](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/apple-opens-siri-ai-app-skills.html): 苹果在最新系统测试版中开放Siri AI应用接入，让第三方软件可通过对话方式向用户提供更复杂的操作。
- [生成媒体推理平台Fal融资13亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/fal-raises-inference-capital.html): 生成媒体推理平台Fal以160亿美元估值融资13亿美元，押注图像、视频和音频模型的调用需求持续增长。
- [狮子山实验室发布 Lion-ER，聚焦具身推理效率](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/lion-er-embodied-reasoning.html): 招商局狮子山人工智能实验室推出 Lion-ER-35B-A3B，强调围绕机器人能力缺口设计数据，而非单纯扩大训练规模。
- [魔芯发布 MoWorld 2.0，推进可交互四维世界模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/moworld-2-4d-world-model.html): 魔芯科技推出基于昇腾原生的 MoWorld 2.0，试图把物理规律、实时渲染和可复用四维资产结合起来。
- [OpenAI让AI代理深入实体工程设计](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-ai-engineering-physical-products.html): OpenAI称GPT-6 Astra与Codex已支持CAD、仿真和制造流程，但工程师仍需逐项审核设计结果。
- [腾讯发布混元 Hy4，首次加入视觉理解能力](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tencent-hy4-visual-open-model.html): 腾讯正式推出混元 Hy4，强化视觉理解、长上下文和多步智能体任务，并计划在近日公开模型权重与系统卡。
- [Anthropic营收冲上170亿美元，IPO前押注近9000亿美元算力](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-ipo-revenue-compute.html): Anthropic最新申报文件显示营收高速增长，但近9000亿美元算力承诺也把前沿模型商业化的风险放到了台前。
- [Anthropic用消息线程降低长上下文Agent等待时间](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-message-threads.html): Anthropic推出消息线程，让每轮请求只发送新增内容，超长请求首个Token延迟中位数下降约35%。
- [华为据报要求部分客户自行采购AI芯片HBM](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/huawei-hbm-procurement-crunch.html): 报道称，华为要求部分AI芯片客户自行寻找高带宽内存，凸显中国AI硬件供应链的关键瓶颈。
- [英伟达要求云服务伙伴降低对中国客户敞口](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/nvidia-cloud-china-exposure.html): 英伟达正要求部分云客户减少中国业务，试图收紧美国芯片管制留下的远程算力通道。
- [OpenAI提出“电网守护者”计划应对数据中心用电压力](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-grid-protectors-program.html): OpenAI提出让AI数据中心参与电网调节的计划，试图缓解算力扩张对本地电力系统造成的压力。

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
